Synopsis:
Wyll appears at camp to confront Karlach, if she was recruited first or is avatar and met Wyll.

Cluster Contexts:
- CAMP_WyllConfrontation_NotRecruited_CFM.json: Wyll suddenly appears in camp to confront Karlach — who may already be a companion or be embodied by the player’s avatar — and carries his blade as the self‑styled Blade of Frontiers. He believes Karlach is an infernal soldier serving Zariel (or at least was seen fighting in Avernus) and has been driven by visions/mind‑meld evidence that she’s a threat. The player and Karlach claim those visions are misleading: Karlach insists she fled Zariel and is a victim of the Blood War, not a willing agent, and the party may have already seen proof backing her up. Off‑screen, then, this is a clash between Wyll’s zealous hunt for devils and the party’s defense of Karlach, which can quickly escalate to violence depending on the player’s intervention.
- Wyll_Recruitment_PostDruidAttack_PostEA.json: Post EADialogue with Wyll after Druid Attack. In most cases, this will involve him training a tiefling child before the player breaks in, and you discover you were both on the mind flayer ship. Wyll comes across as a big-time hero, and wants help killing goblins. He is called the Blade of Frontiers by most.
- Wyll_Recruitment_PostEA.json: Post EA dialog version.Initial dialogue with Wyll. In most cases, this will involve him training a tiefling child before the player breaks in, and you discover you were both on the mind flayer ship. Wyll comes across as a big-time hero, and wants help killing goblins. He is called the Blade of Frontiers by most.
- CAMP_WyllConfrontation_IVB_CFM.json: Karlach and Wyll meet at the camp and start a discussion. If not defused by the player it could escalate to Wyll or Karlach permanently leaving the party hostile.
- DEN_AttackOnDen_Wyll.json: Wyll dialogue if he is an NPC and is in the goblin camp after attack on den victory. In paths where the attack has yet to begin, Wyll is enthusiastic for you to blow the horn and call for battle. After battle, you can recruit Wyll.
